questions.question: Every shell command is refused here: `sandbox.bash` is enabled but bubblewrap can't create a namespace on this host, and that setting is guarded — only you can change it. How should I close out the verification owed for the settings.ini edit?

options.label: I've set sandbox.bash off — re-run `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6`
options.description: Settings -> Sandbox -> bash = off (or [sandbox] bash = "off" in config.toml); I then run the byte dump and record it as the verification.

options.label: I'll run `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` myself and paste the output
options.description: You supply the real command output; I compare it against the expected byte listing.

options.label: Accept the edit receipt and read_file as verification, skip the shell check
options.description: No command runs; the record shows the one-occurrence replacement plus the re-read file contents.
